data.narrative:
Skild AI, a Series C AI & Software company founded by Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta, carries a current post-money valuation of $14.0B following $1.4B+ in total capital raised. The peer universe comprises 3 same-stage private comparables in AI & Software—Figure AI ($39.0B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), and Together AI ($8.3B)—supplemented by 8 additional frontier-tech private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir, PLTR).

Two valuation methods triangulate defensible value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier to the $14.0B last post-money round, implying $23.8B; this reflects typical step-up patterns moving from Series C to later stages. Peer-median analysis yields $10.0B, derived from the median of the 3-company same-stage, same-sector cohort, with observed range of $8.3B to $39.0B. The methodological divergence reflects meaningful dispersion in recent AI company valuations at this stage.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $8.5B (floor, near peer minimum) to $27.4B (ceiling, stage-progression multiple applied to current round), with a median point of $16.9B. The current $14.0B valuation sits near the lower-median bound. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to peers, capital efficiency, and the sustainability of stage-progression multiples in a shifting venture market for frontier AI.
